_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: Statistically a coil: 30d momentum mid-range, funding flat, and sub-basis net exchange outflow give no breaker—HOLD is the graded call until momentum or Fear & Greed exits the band.
next_move.brains_agree: partial split — analyst explicit HOLD/Hope coil; narrative silent on phase, only flow microstructure
next_move.confirmed_if: Fear & Greed holds 55-70 and 30d momentum stays ~45-60 with funding still flat
next_move.invalidated_if: Momentum breaks under 40 with F&G under 55 and CVD rollover (down to Disbelief), or momentum through 70 with funding lifting (up to Optimism)
